caseName: Thanh Vong Hoai v. Thanh Van Vo
caseNameFull: Thanh Vong Hoai v. Thanh Van Vo

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of Vietnamese Community of Washington, D. C., Maryland, and Virginia for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Thomas took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
